verdict.rationale: GitLab's docs describe AI agents that automatically act on events—turning issues into merge requests and remediating vulnerabilities—showing event-triggered automation, and security findings auto-surface in MRs/IDEs. However, there is no explicit documentation of a rules-definition mechanism (e.g., custom event/condition/action rule builder) for AI-native workflows beyond these built-in agent behaviors. missing for 10: explicit rule-definition/configuration interface for custom event-action triggers, independent verification of agent automation working reliably.
